note: the same program in every participating language must yield these counts. Asserts the roles the four languages genuinely SHARE: (_callable) is here because it is a facet, so it only works through roles.json expansion and proves that path. (_clause) is deliberately absent — clause membership is language-specific by nature (python comprehensions have for/if clauses, typescript imports have an import_clause, rust models else inside if_expression rather than as an else_clause node), which is exactly why it lives in the facet tier. A rosetta case can only assert what the languages share.
